# Pinball Map — account brief

## Who
Pinball Map runs a website and a free mobile app that help people find places to play pinball, described on its homepage as a user-updated locator for the public pinball machines in your area ([source](https://pinballmap.com/)). Its GitHub org lists 8 public repos and 20 followers ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in pinballmap/pbm-react ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/eas.json)).
- The repo's package.json pins react-native 0.86.0 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json)).
- pbm-react was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react)).

## Who to talk to
- Ryan TG (@RyanTG), top contributor to pbm-react with 1286 commits; profile lists location Los Angeles, website https://blueskiesabove.us, and the bio "I like working on Pinball Map and fixing typos in other people's projects." ([source](https://github.com/RyanTG))
- Beth Poore (@bpoore), 538 commits to pbm-react; profile lists location Portland, OR ([source](https://github.com/bpoore)).
- Scott Wainstock (@scottwainstock), 31 commits to pbm-react; profile lists company AWS, location Portland, OR, and website http://pinballmap.com ([source](https://github.com/scottwainstock)).

## Why now
pbm-react was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react)) and pins react-native 0.86.0 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json)). The evidence contains no app store release history, so store update cadence is unknown.

## Suggested opener
Ryan, you have 1286 commits to pinballmap/pbm-react, more than anyone else on the repo ([source](https://github.com/RyanTG)). The repo carries an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/eas.json)), pins react-native 0.86.0 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json)), and was last pushed on 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react)). After a push like that one, what does the path from commit to a build users can install look like for you today?
